briefings.title: Stripe CEO Patrick Collison at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Stripe CEO Patrick Collison discussed Stripe’s $7.5 billion acquisition of OpenRouter as a parallel to Stripe’s own neutral infrastructure—unifying AI tokens rather than dollars—while outlining the rise of an "AI economy" driven by agent-to-agent micropayments, the enduring value of human-made art, and the urgent need for meta-science reform.

briefings.title: Sam Altman: ‘It’s Hard To Imagine the AI Revolution Without Jensen’ | Silicon Valley & The World
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman addressed the ouster of Nvidia's Jensen Huang, defended the massive debt- and capex-backed buildout of AI infrastructure despite voter backlash and memory shortages, and argued that the AI industry must commit to keeping humans in control of the future rather than rushing into unmonitored recursive self-improvement.

briefings.title: DeepMind Chief Demis Hassabis Says Google’s Still Winning AI Talent | Semafor Tech
briefings.tldr: Despite escalating industry competition and high-profile departures, Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis remains confident in Google's leading research bench and its multi-pronged, simulation-based path toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).
